image_description: A close-up photograph of a young child blowing soap bubbles. The child is holding a bubble wand with a foamy, pinkish residue on the loop. A large, translucent bubble is forming at the child's mouth, exhibiting strong specular highlights and iridescent coloration (pinks, greens). Several other out-of-focus bubbles float in the background. The lighting appears to be indoor flash photography, creating harsh reflections.

Significant motion blur or focus softness on the fingers holding the wand. While this could be photographic motion blur, in AI generation, it often masks structural ambiguities in finger placement.
The background bubbles have very soft, indistinct edges that blend into the background wall slightly more than typical optical bokeh, suggesting minor edge-bleeding artifacts.
